missing.title: Project not found
missing.description: “{name}” belongs to a project that isn't where it used to be. The file still looks the same, but until the project is found its library items can't be edited and changes made in other files don't arrive.

readOnly.title: Library items can't be edited
readOnly.description: This file's project wasn't found. Locate it to edit library items again.

move.title: Move to “{library}”?
move.collection_one: Moves the collection “{collection}” with its {count} variable to “{library}”.
move.collection_other: Moves the collection “{collection}” with its {count} variables to “{library}”.
move.shared: Every file that uses the library gets it, and editing it in any of them updates them all.
move.refused: It refers to variables that would stay in this file: {names}. Move those first, or stop referring to them.

libraries.title: Libraries
libraries.unavailable: The project's libraries aren't open, so they can't be turned on or off now.
libraries.none: This project has no libraries yet.
libraries.hint: A library that's on brings its variables and styles into this file.
libraries.leaveText_one: {count} layer uses its variables and styles. It keeps how it looks, unlinked from the library.
libraries.leaveText_other: {count} layers use its variables and styles. They keep how they look, unlinked from the library.
